authority.policy: R48 artefacts are immutable historical evidence; R49 is a successor contract.

conventions.triad: orthonormal invariant spatial triad unless otherwise stated
conventions.structure_constants: C^alpha_(beta gamma) = epsilon_(beta gamma delta) n^(delta alpha) + a_beta delta^alpha_gamma - a_gamma delta^alpha_beta
conventions.warning: Legacy StructureConstants and BianchiAlgebra representations must be bridged explicitly; do not assume identical axis, epsilon or sign conventions.

bianchi_families.tilt_admissibility: constraint_restricted; classical irrotational tilted branches exist
restricted tilted self-similar branches; validate full general time-dependent state

genuinely tilted perfect-fluid branches may require fluid vorticity
constraint/model dependent; closed-curvature and fluid-vorticity sectors required
VI_h boundary; special restrictions; preserve exact h=-1 bridge
family-specific Class-B constraints; unresolved general branch registry
tilted dynamical systems and irrotational subclasses exist

normal_congruence.rule: Do not identify normal kinematics with matter-fluid kinematics.

derived_stress.S_ab: p_s h_ab + (epsilon_s + p_s) Gamma_s^2 V_s_a V_s_b

observer_frames.composition: exact ordered Lorentz composition; propagate Wigner rotation to tensors, polarization bases and covariance

cmb.model_mean: isotropic realization plus deterministic Bianchi mean template plus exact observer remapping
cmb.covariance: full anisotropic harmonic covariance including stochastic mode coupling, beam, mask, foreground and noise
cmb.rule: Mean-template and BipoSH/covariance readouts of the same a_lm are one generative likelihood, not independent factors.

counts.likelihood: survey-specific marked point processes with selection, redshift, flux/size response, completeness, shot noise and clustering covariance
counts.rule: No hard-coded dipole, selection coefficient, inferred random catalogue or default diagonal covariance.

astrometry.rule: B1 VSH is not vorticity absent independently calibrated frame-spin anchor.

distances.local_law: H_u(e) = theta_u/3 - A_u.e/c + sigma_u_ab e^a e^b
distances.finite_redshift: integrated optical/redshift map with truncation remainder

expansion_control.rule: Use only angularly resolved estimators for directional anisotropy; isotropic BAO is a background control.

htt_five_views.x: sample x functional; preserve tensor rank, parity, units, frame, epoch, source operator, state identity
htt_five_views.Q: anchor/gauge/margin bodies from source or theorem; unavailable stays unavailable
htt_five_views.Pi: law-conditional exceedance under explicitly named posterior or matched-null law
htt_five_views.F: directional support and occupancy relative to admitted anchor body
htt_five_views.G_F: depth path across redshift shells using full data and cross-shell covariance
htt_five_views.invariant: x,Q,Pi,F,G_F are derived views of one common posterior/compatibility law, never independent likelihood factors

role: observed map robustness after transfer harmonization
prohibited: PR3 FFP10 treated as PR4 matched null
half-ring difference treated as full CMB+noise ensemble
PR3 and PR4 samples mixed into one matched-null distribution
pr4_npipe.optional_synthetic_null: declared C_l plus validated NPIPE noise model; SYNTHETIC/TRANSFER_CONDITIONAL only

fail_closed_rules: Missing sources, covariance, selection, frame, beam, transfer or response calibration must raise/mark UNAVAILABLE; never substitute zeros, identity covariance, random directions or hard-coded observed carriers.
A mock cannot enter a real-data likelihood.
A type label cannot be promoted from curvature-only fingerprints where group actions are degenerate.
No Bianchi family identification without family-specific physical transfer and separated competitors.
No independent factorization of five HTT views.
No full-sky or finite-redshift approximation is silently extrapolated beyond its derived domain.

algebra: Jacobi residual for all family fixtures
SO(3) triad covariance and parity tests
cmb: no double counting of template and covariance
